shared_gaps.engine_rating: Exact simulator rating and per-livery/airframe engine applicability are not established by fleet powerplant labels.
shared_gaps.displayed_target: No current-build simulator observation establishes displayed takeoff target type/units or native numerical thrust solution. Candidate classes are investigation leads only.
shared_gaps.native_perf: Documented FMS/system availability does not establish exact PERF-page outputs, available modes or automatic FLEX/ATM-to-target behavior.
shared_gaps.profile_equivalence: Public SimBrief catalog identity/data flags do not establish exact simulator engine, rating, tanks, loading or configuration equivalence.
shared_gaps.performance_output: Runway-data flag is a catalog advertisement, not an observed OFP, target or feasible performance solution.
shared_gaps.simulator_acceptance: No simulator import, usable thrust-setting instruction or numerical accuracy verification was performed for this snapshot.

changes.assessment: A330-200/Archer addition; basic 777 EFB; navigation and DST changes. No numeric thrust applicability established.
C-130 propeller visual fix; no thrust-model conclusion.
A330-800neo addition; planning undo, fuel service and cargo-import fixes. Inspect imported loads separately from thrust.
A350-1000 addition and Flight Assist; not evidence for a manual thrust translation.
A321neo addition, MCDU editing and SimBrief briefing/V-speed import. Native numerical thrust resolution remains unverified.
A321neo reverse-thrust guidance/ECAM and navigation fixes; do not treat indication fixes as new takeoff targets.
A320neo addition and broad cockpit/fuel/navigation work. Recheck profile and native behavior before duplicating it; no universal thrust-model change inferred.
737 APU indication correction; no takeoff-thrust conclusion. Android also has build20234 dated October30.
F/A-18E display and SimBrief duplicate-import/reauth fixes. Public release baseline; not observed on an owner device.
Specific official systems list documents working flight-management and fuel systems; individual PERF outputs still need observation.
Shading work is explicitly visual; it does not establish changed flight/thrust behavior.
